_readme: Photos of Akash Reddy for the Photos section of /gallery, newest first. Each one also goes into the Gallery page's ImageGallery JSON-LD, the Person entity's images and the image sitemap, so search engines tie the photo to his name. Fields: file (site path), width and height (the real pixel size; the build checks), title (short, name first), alt (what the photo shows, with his name), caption (shown under the photo). To add photos: upload them on the admin page (reachakash.com/admin, Photos; GitHub Actions then runs _build/process-photos.js), or drop them in photos-inbox/ (git-ignored, never published) and ask Claude to add them. Either way they get resized to 1600px on the long side, stripped of camera and GPS data, tagged with node _build/photo-meta.js, saved in images/photos/ with a name-first filename, and listed here.
